translations.idiomatic: The reception of the spirits uses "Everlasting Harmony" in Linzhong gong—composed by Xu Yanbo, Attendant Cavalier and Zhaowen Hall Scholar.

translations.literal: Colon introducing the hymn text:
translations.idiomatic: The hymn reads:

translations.literal: How admirable the pure temple; solemn, solemn, glittering bright.
translations.idiomatic: How fair the pure temple; solemn and shimmering bright.

translations.literal: The state presents the solemn sacrifice; the Kun chariot and the gentle spirit.
translations.idiomatic: The realm offers this solemn rite; Earth's carriage bears the gentle spirit.

translations.literal: There is the offering table in the chamber; there is music in the courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: The offering table waits in the hall; music fills the court.

translations.literal: Facing this filial offering; the hundred blessings alone are at peace.
translations.idiomatic: Before this filial feast, all blessings find their rest.

translations.literal: Golden performance, Yize palace mode; author not recorded in detail.
translations.idiomatic: The golden performance, in Yize gong—the composer is unknown.

translations.literal: One edition lacks this sequence.
translations.idiomatic: One recension omits this section.

translations.literal: Colon introducing the hymn text:
translations.idiomatic: The hymn reads:

translations.literal: The yin spirit shows its blessing; Xuanyuan's radiance descends essence.
translations.idiomatic: The yin spirit brings blessing; stellar radiance sends down its essence.

translations.literal: Auspicious tally, gentle qi; felicitations gather, soft and bright.
translations.idiomatic: Auspicious signs and gentle breath; blessings gather in soft radiance.

translations.literal: Jade offering stands already arrayed; carved paulownia emits sound.
translations.idiomatic: Jade altars stand in array; carved paulownia sounds forth.

translations.literal: Fine principles forever distant; comparing virtue to Imperial Ying.
translations.idiomatic: Her merit endures forever; her virtue matches Imperial Ying.

sentences.zh: 皇帝行用《太和》黃鐘宮，左諭德、昭文館學士邱說撰。

translations.literal: For the emperor's procession, use "Taihe," Huangzhong palace mode—composed by Left Mentor, Zhaowen Hall Academician, Qiu Shuo.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's procession uses "Supreme Harmony" in Huangzhong gong—composed by Qiu Shuo, Left Mentor and Zhaowen Hall Scholar.

translations.literal: Colon introducing the hymn text:
translations.idiomatic: The hymn reads:

translations.literal: Filial indeed our sovereign; profound indeed is sageliness.
translations.idiomatic: How filial is our sovereign—how profound his sage virtue!

translations.literal: The Way reflects Chonghua; virtue radiates Wenming.
translations.idiomatic: His Way mirrors Emperor Shun; his virtue shines like Yu the Great.

translations.literal: Longing deep—viewing the casket; feeling earnest—stroking the mirror.
translations.idiomatic: With deep longing he reads ancestral records; with earnest love he grieves before their mirror.

translations.literal: Ten thousand states shift customs; a trillion people receive felicity.
translations.idiomatic: All lands follow his transforming influence; countless people share his blessings.

sentences.zh: 酌獻登歌用《肅和》中呂均之太簇羽，一雲蕤賓均之夾鐘羽，太子洗馬、昭文館學士張齊賢撰：

translations.literal: For libation offering and ascent hymn, use "Suhe," Taicu yu under the Zhonglu tonal standard; one text says Ruibin yu under the Jiazhong standard—composed by Crown Prince's Secretary, Zhaowen Hall Academician Zhang Qixian:
translations.idiomatic: The libation and ascent hymn use "Solemn Harmony," in Taicu yu under the Zhonglü key (one recension has Jiazhong yu under the Ruibin key)—composed by Zhang Qixian, Crown Prince's Secretary and Zhaowen Hall Scholar:

translations.literal: Black-millet jade tablets already washed; aromatic wine already displayed.
translations.idiomatic: The jade scepters have been purified; the fragrant wine stands ready.

translations.literal: Painted veils like clouds rising; yellow stream jade-pure.
translations.idiomatic: Painted covers rise like clouds; the golden libation runs clear as jade.

translations.literal: Rites complete in offering libation; ceremony grand for all sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: The rite of offering is complete; the sacrificial ceremony reaches its height.

translations.literal: Earth discerns filial piety; joyfully thus feasting the kin.
translations.idiomatic: Earth itself discerns true filial piety; with joy we feast our forebears.

sentences.zh: 迎俎用《雍和》姑洗羽，太中大夫、昭文館學士鄭善玉作。

translations.literal: For welcoming offering stands, use "Yonghe," Guxian feather—composed by Grand Master of Palace Affairs, Zhaowen Hall Academician Zheng Shanyu.
translations.idiomatic: Welcoming the sacrificial stands uses "Harmonious Peace," in Guxian yu—composed by Zheng Shanyu, Grand Master of Palace Affairs and Zhaowen Hall Scholar.

translations.literal: Colon introducing the hymn text:
translations.idiomatic: The hymn reads:

translations.literal: Fragrant wine already poured in libation; taking fragrant mugwort, then kindling.
translations.idiomatic: The aromatic wine has been poured; fragrant herbs are gathered and burned.

translations.literal: Baskets and cups still and excellent; grain vessels fragrant and savory.
translations.idiomatic: Baskets and cups stand in quiet splendor; grain vessels breathe sweet fragrance.

translations.literal: Fish and cured meats presented, excellent; sacrificial beasts display purity.
translations.idiomatic: Fish and cured meats are offered in excellence; the sacrificial beasts show spotless purity.

translations.literal: Thus gathering, thus advancing; then welcoming, then arraying.
translations.idiomatic: They are gathered and borne forward, welcomed and set in order.

sentences.zh: 肅明皇后室酌獻用《昭升》林鐘宮，禮部尚書、昭文館學士薛稷作。

translations.literal: For libation at Empress Suming's shrine, use "Zhaosheng," Linzhong palace—composed by Minister of Rites, Zhaowen Hall Academician Xue Ji.
translations.idiomatic: The libation at Empress Suming's shrine uses "Bright Ascent," in Linzhong gong—composed by Xue Ji, Minister of Rites and Zhaowen Hall Scholar.

translations.literal: Colon introducing the hymn text:
translations.idiomatic: The hymn reads:

translations.literal: Yang spirit matches virtue; yin soul brightly ascends.
translations.idiomatic: The yang spirit shares in virtue; the yin soul rises in radiant light.

translations.literal: At Yao's altar a phoenix descended; the Han house a dragon arose.
translations.idiomatic: A phoenix descended on Yao's altar; a dragon rose to found the Han.

translations.literal: Matching Heaven as counterpart; the hanging beads before are fixed in focus.
translations.idiomatic: She stands as Heaven's counterpart; the jeweled tassels hang steadfast before her brow.

translations.literal: Transformations spread through southern lands; the Way flourishes at Xiling.
translations.idiomatic: Her transforming influence spread through the southern realms; her teaching flourished at Xiling.

translations.literal: Building boats to gather the spring; with no virtue by which to name her.

translations.idiomatic: Music sends the spirit forth—may he witness and approve the rite's end.

translations.literal: Six hymn sequences for Crown Prince Zhanghuai's temple, composed at the beginning of the Shenlong era
translations.idiomatic: Six hymns for the Temple of Crown Prince Zhanghuai, composed early in the Shenlong reign

translations.literal: Welcoming spirits, first sequence, Guxian palace mode:
translations.idiomatic: First hymn—Welcoming the Spirits, Guxian gong:

translations.literal: Secondary ruler displays emblems; Way corresponds to Li of the Canon.
translations.idiomatic: The heir apparent displays his signs; his Way answers to Li in the Book of Changes.

translations.literal: Bronze tower prepares virtue; jade abundance completes rule.
translations.idiomatic: At the bronze tower his virtue was nurtured; jade standards shaped his bearing.

translations.literal: Immortal aura misty-misty; spirit attendants orderly-orderly.
translations.idiomatic: Immortal mist gathers thick; spirit attendants mass in ordered ranks.

translations.literal: Advance guard arrives and stops; controlling cranes, coming with ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: Outriders halt at last; reining cranes, he comes in ritual splendor.

sentences.zh: 登歌酌鬯第二南呂均之蕤賓羽：

translations.literal: Ascent hymn and libation, second sequence, Ruibin yu under the Nanlü tonal standard:
translations.idiomatic: Second hymn—Ascent and Libation, Ruibin yu in the Nanlü key:

translations.literal: Filial piety rooted and evident; wings and pinions first completed.
translations.idiomatic: Loyalty and filial piety were his nature; his wings were formed early.

translations.literal: Bedchamber gate displays virtue; imperial road as measure.
translations.idiomatic: At the bedchamber gate his virtue shone; the imperial roadway marked his course.

translations.literal: Silks have canon; appearance guard without sound.
translations.idiomatic: Silks were offered by the canon; his guard passed in silent dignity.

translations.literal: Officers present already solemn; temple offering only pure.
translations.idiomatic: The officers stand in solemn order; the temple offering keeps its clarity.

sentences.zh: 迎俎及酌獻第三大呂羽

translations.literal: Welcoming offering stands and libation offering, third sequence, Dalü yu
translations.idiomatic: Third hymn—Welcoming Stands and Libation, Dalü yu

translations.literal: Through three bestowals continuing the line; bright pair inheriting glory.
translations.idiomatic: Through threefold grace the line continues; paired luminaries inherit glory.

translations.literal: Mount Tai compared in brilliance; Yi waters hear pipes.
translations.idiomatic: Bright as Mount Tai he shone; by Yi waters pipes sound in his memory.

translations.literal: Ancestral temple is entrusted; rites and music thereby flourish.
translations.idiomatic: The ancestral line rests in him; through rites and music all prospers.

translations.literal: Auspicious day presenting stands; thereby issuing sound and brilliance.
translations.idiomatic: On this blessed day stands are offered; brilliance speaks through the rite.

sentences.zh: 送文舞出、迎武舞入第四蕤賓商：

translations.literal: Sending out civil dance and welcoming martial dance entering, fourth sequence, Ruibin shang:
translations.idiomatic: Fourth hymn—Civil Dance Out, Martial Dance In, Ruibin shang:

sentences.zh: 羽龠崇文禮以畢，幹戚奮武事將行。

translations.literal: Feather-flutes honor civil rites as completed; shield-axes rouse martial affairs about to proceed.
translations.idiomatic: Feather-flutes honor civil rites now complete; shield-axes stir martial display about to begin.

sentences.zh: 用舍由來其有致，壯志宣威樂太平。

translations.literal: Use and discard from of old have their pattern; bold will proclaims majesty, rejoicing in great peace.
translations.idiomatic: Use and disuse have ever held their logic; bold will proclaims power, rejoicing in peace.

translations.literal: Martial dance, fifth sequence, Yize jue:
translations.idiomatic: Fifth hymn—Martial Dance, Yize jue:

sentences.zh: 綠林熾炎曆，黃虞格有苗。

translations.literal: Green woods blaze in Yan calendar; Yellow Yu subdues You-Miao.
translations.idiomatic: Green armies blazed in the fiery age; the age of Yu subdued the Miao.

sentences.zh: 沙塵驚塞外，帷幄命嫖姚。

translations.literal: Dust and sand startled beyond the frontier; tent headquarters commands Piao Yao.
translations.idiomatic: Dust storms shook the frontier; from camp headquarters Huo Qubing took command.

translations.literal: "Seven Virtues": weapons and halberds cease; three frontiers' clouds and mist dissolve.
translations.idiomatic: The "Seven Virtues" stilled arms; clouds cleared on every border.

sentences.zh: 寶祚長無極，歌舞盛今朝。

translations.literal: Precious throne long without limit; song and dance flourish this morning.
translations.idiomatic: The sacred throne endures without end; song and dance fill this day.

translations.literal: Sending off spirits, sixth sequence; lyrics same as Hidden Prince temple.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth hymn—Sending Off the Spirits, with the same lyrics as the Hidden Crown Prince's Temple.

sentences.zh: 懿德太子廟樂章六首神龍初作

translations.literal: Six hymn sequences for Crown Prince Yide's temple, composed at the beginning of the Shenlong era
translations.idiomatic: Six hymns for the Temple of Crown Prince Yide, composed early in the Shenlong reign

translations.literal: Welcoming spirits, first sequence, Guxian palace mode:
translations.idiomatic: First hymn—Welcoming the Spirits, Guxian gong:

translations.literal: Jia Palace displays auspice; painted hall ascends to rank.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Palace showed good omens; in the painted hall he rose to rank.

translations.literal: Rites surpass all princes; gazing up to honor the heir secondary.
translations.idiomatic: In rites he stood above all princes; all looked up to the honored heir.

translations.literal: Qi and Song ashamed of virtue; Zhuang and Pi overshadow pure essence.
translations.idiomatic: Beside Qi and Song his virtue shames them; Zhuang and Pi cannot hide his pure light.

translations.literal: Yi shore: phoenix soars; Gou peak: crane arrives.
translations.idiomatic: At Yi waters phoenixes soar; at Mount Gou cranes descend.

sentences.zh: 登歌酌鬯第二南呂均之蕤賓羽：

translations.literal: Ascent hymn and libation, second sequence, Ruibin yu under the Nanlü tonal standard:
translations.idiomatic: Second hymn—Ascent and Libation, Ruibin yu in the Nanlü key:

translations.literal: Fame spreads for primary heir; entrusted to illumine clarity of pair.
translations.idiomatic: His renown illumines the heir; entrusted to shine with paired glory.

translations.literal: Jade abundance though dimmed; bronze tower can be recalled.
translations.idiomatic: Jade grace though veiled; the bronze tower lives in memory.

translations.literal: Strings and recitation halt sound; pipes and songs cease resonance.
translations.idiomatic: Strings and study fall silent; pipes and songs have ceased.

translations.literal: Silks by word set out; ritual appearance without deviation.
translations.idiomatic: Silks are laid as ordained; ritual bearing shows no lapse.

translations.literal: Welcoming offering stands and libation offering, third sequence, Dalü yu:
translations.idiomatic: Third hymn—Welcoming Stands and Libation, Dalü yu:

translations.literal: Harmonious harmonious grand ceremony; solemn solemn spirit shrine.
translations.idiomatic: Grand and harmonious the ceremony; solemn the spirit's shrine.

translations.literal: Guesting heaven has sage; facing sun without term.
translations.idiomatic: He guests with heaven's sage; facing the sun—with no appointed day.

translations.literal: Drifting drifting feather robes; drawing trailing cloud banners.
translations.idiomatic: Feather robes drift lightly; cloud banners trail behind.

translations.literal: Looking to chief libation; heart here grief-stricken.
translations.idiomatic: Turning to the chief libation—the heart grieves for him here.

sentences.zh: 送文舞出迎武舞入第四蕤賓商：

translations.literal: Sending out civil dance and welcoming martial dance entering, fourth sequence, Ruibin shang:
translations.idiomatic: Fourth hymn—Civil Dance Out, Martial Dance In, Ruibin shang:

sentences.zh: 八音協奏陳金石，六佾分行整禮容。

translations.literal: Eight sounds jointly perform, displaying metal and stone; six rows separately arrayed, setting ritual bearing.
translations.idiomatic: Eight tones join—metal and stone displayed; six rows align—ritual bearing perfected.

sentences.zh: 滄溟赴海還稱少，素月開輪即是重。

translations.literal: Blue sea rushing to ocean still called small; pure moon opening wheel precisely is heavy.
translations.idiomatic: Even all oceans pouring to the sea seem small; the plain moon wheel rising is weight enough.

translations.literal: Martial dance, fifth sequence, Yize jue:
translations.idiomatic: Fifth hymn—Martial Dance, Yize jue:

sentences.zh: 隋季昔雲終，唐年初啟聖。

translations.literal: Sui season in past cloud ended; Tang year at beginning opens sagehood.
translations.idiomatic: The Sui age once seemed ended; at Tang's dawn sacred rule began.

sentences.zh: 纂戎將禁暴，崇儒更敷政。

translations.literal: Gathering arms will forbid violence; honoring Confucians further spreads governance.
translations.idiomatic: He took up arms to end cruelty; he honored scholars and spread good rule.

sentences.zh: 威略靜三邊，仁恩覃萬姓。

translations.literal: Prestige and strategy quiet three frontiers; benevolence and grace spread over myriad surnames.
translations.idiomatic: His might stilled the three borders; his kindness reached every household.

translations.literal: Sending off spirits, sixth sequence; lyrics same as Hidden Prince temple.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth hymn—Sending Off the Spirits, with the same lyrics as the Hidden Crown Prince's Temple.

sentences.zh: 節湣太子廟樂章六首景雲中作

translations.literal: Six hymn sequences for Crown Prince Jiemin's temple, composed in the Jingyun era
translations.idiomatic: Six hymns for the Temple of Crown Prince Shao, composed in the Jingyun reign

translations.literal: Welcoming spirits, first sequence, Guxian palace mode:
translations.idiomatic: First hymn—Welcoming the Spirits, Guxian gong:

translations.literal: Heir reserve gazing-up honored; prime son entrusted urgent.
translations.idiomatic: All eyes looked up to the honored heir; hope rested urgently in the crown prince.

translations.literal: Bedchamber gate is looked up to; imperial road unceasing.
translations.idiomatic: At the bedchamber gate all looked up to him; traffic on the imperial road never ceased.

translations.literal: Immortal sleeves clouds gather; spirit banners lightning bright.
translations.idiomatic: Immortal sleeves gather like clouds; spirit banners flash like lightning.

translations.literal: Brilliant brilliant thus coming; ritual gifts thereupon set.
translations.idiomatic: He comes in radiant splendor; ritual gifts are laid in place.

sentences.zh: 登歌酌鬯第二南呂均之蕤賓羽：

translations.literal: Ascent hymn and libation, second sequence, Ruibin yu under the Nanlü tonal standard:
translations.idiomatic: Second hymn—Ascent and Libation, Ruibin yu in the Nanlü key:

translations.literal: Flaming flaming double brightness; looking up receiving head-node.
translations.idiomatic: Bright as paired suns he shone; he looked up to serve the sovereign.

translations.literal: Already virtuous also wise; only filial and fraternal.
translations.idiomatic: Wise and virtuous both; devoted in filial piety and brotherhood.

translations.literal: Only filial though distant; spirit rule not decaying.
translations.idiomatic: Though far in death, his filial piety endures; his spirit's example never fades.

translations.literal: Sacrifice through sincerity attained; prepared pure dark wine.
translations.idiomatic: The rite reaches him through sincerity; pure water and dark wine are made ready.

sentences.zh: 迎俎及酌獻第三大呂羽：

translations.literal: Welcoming offering stands and libation offering, third sequence, Dalü yu:
translations.idiomatic: Third hymn—Welcoming Stands and Libation, Dalü yu:

translations.literal: Fine offerings have canon; utmost sincerity without fault.
translations.idiomatic: Fine offerings follow the canon; utmost sincerity knows no lapse.

translations.literal: Painted beams clouds alternating; carved stands stars linked.
translations.idiomatic: Painted beams mingle like clouds; carved stands rank like stars.

translations.literal: Musical instruments all around arrayed; ritual bearing prepared and proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: Instruments stand arrayed on every side; ritual bearing is fully displayed.

translations.literal: Dimly dimly as if present; as if not yet guesting heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Dimly he seems still present—as though he had not yet gone to heaven.

sentences.zh: 送文舞出、迎武舞入第四蕤賓商：

translations.literal: Sending out civil dance and welcoming martial dance entering, fourth sequence, Ruibin shang:
translations.idiomatic: Fourth hymn—Civil Dance Out, Martial Dance In, Ruibin shang:

sentences.zh: 邕邕闡化憑文德，赫赫宣威藉武功。

translations.literal: Harmonious harmonious spreading transformation relying on civil virtue; brilliant brilliant proclaiming majesty by martial achievement.
translations.idiomatic: Harmoniously he spread culture through civil virtue; brilliantly he proclaimed power through martial might.

sentences.zh: 既執羽旄先拂吹，還持玉戚更揮空。

translations.literal: Already holding feather-banner first brushes flute; then holding jade axe further sweeps empty.
translations.idiomatic: Feather-staves brush past the flutes; jade axes sweep the empty air.

translations.literal: Martial dance, fifth sequence, Yize jue:
translations.idiomatic: Fifth hymn—Martial Dance, Yize jue:

sentences.zh: 武德諒雄雄，由來掃寇戎。

translations.literal: Martial virtue indeed heroic-heroic; from of old sweeping bandit barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: Military virtue was truly heroic; of old he swept away raiders from the frontiers.

sentences.zh: 劍光揮作電，旗影列成虹。

translations.literal: Sword light brandished as lightning; banner shadows arrayed forming rainbow.
translations.idiomatic: Sword flashes cut like lightning; banners rank in arcs like rainbows.

sentences.zh: 霧廓三邊靜，波澄四海同。

translations.literal: Mist cleared three frontiers quiet; waves cleared four seas same.
translations.idiomatic: Mists cleared—the three borders stilled; waves stilled—all four seas at peace.

sentences.zh: 睿圖今已盛，相共舞皇風。

translations.literal: Sage chart now already flourishing; mutually together dancing imperial wind.
translations.idiomatic: The sage design now flourishes; together they dance the imperial Way.

sentences.zh: 送神第六詞同隱太子廟。

translations.literal: Sending off spirits, sixth sequence; lyrics same as Hidden Crown Prince temple.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth hymn—Sending Off the Spirits, with the same lyrics as the Hidden Crown Prince's Temple.

sentences.zh: 則天大聖皇后崇先廟樂章一首禦撰

translations.literal: One hymn sequence for Empress Zetian the Great Sage's Ancestor-Revering Temple, imperially composed
translations.idiomatic: One hymn for the Ancestor-Revering Temple of Empress Wu the Great Sage, composed by the throne

sentences.zh: 先德謙捴冠昔，嚴規節素超今。

translations.literal: Forebears' virtue humble-concealed crowns the past; strict rule frugal-plain surpasses today.
translations.idiomatic: Our forebears' humble virtue surpassed all before; their strict, plain ways exceed our age.

sentences.zh: 奉國忠誠每竭，承家至孝純深。

translations.literal: Serving state loyal sincerity each exhausted; inheriting family utmost filial pure deep.
translations.idiomatic: In service to the state their loyalty knew no limit; in family duty their filial piety ran pure and deep.

sentences.zh: 追崇懼乖尊意，顯號恐玷徽音。

translations.literal: Pursuing honor fearing going against honored intent; displaying title fearing staining emblem sound.
translations.idiomatic: To honor them posthumously—yet fearing to violate their wishes; to grant a lofty title—yet fearing to tarnish their fair name.

sentences.zh: 既迫王公屢請，方乃俯遂群心。

translations.literal: Already pressed by princes and dukes repeatedly requesting; then bowing to follow multitude heart.
translations.idiomatic: When princes and lords pressed their repeated petitions, at last she bowed to the people's will.

sentences.zh: 有限無由展敬，奠醑每闕親斟。

translations.literal: Limited finite without means displaying reverence; setting wine each lack personally pouring.
translations.idiomatic: Life's bounds left no way to show full reverence; each offering cup lacked her own hand to pour.

sentences.zh: 大禮虔申典冊，蘋藻敬薦翹襟。

translations.literal: Great rites reverently declared in canon records; duckweed and pondweed reverently offered, raised breast.
translations.idiomatic: With reverent care she followed the canon of great rites; with duckweed and herbs she offered from a bowed heart.

sentences.zh: 褒德廟樂章五首神龍中為皇后韋氏祖考所立，詞並內出。

translations.literal: Five hymn sequences for Baode Temple, established in Shenlong era for Empress Wei clan's forefathers; lyrics all issued from within.
translations.idiomatic: Five hymns for the Baode Temple, established in the Shenlong reign for the ancestors of Empress Wei; all lyrics issued from the inner court.

sentences.zh: 迎神用《昭德》姑洗宮二成：

translations.literal: For welcoming spirits, use "Zhaode"; Guxian palace mode, two sequences:
translations.idiomatic: Welcoming the spirits uses "Manifest Virtue," Guxian gong, two parts:

translations.literal: Way brilliant in Wutong Palace; grief filling Artemisia Lane.
translations.idiomatic: Their Way shone bright as at the Palace of Wu; grief fills the burial grounds.

translations.literal: Thereupon spreading emblem glory; bearing spreading fine sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: There they spread their honored fame; there they hold this splendid rite.

translations.literal: Offerings permeate four seasons; rule displays two gui.
translations.idiomatic: Offerings reach through all four seasons; by canon two gui bowls are set.

translations.literal: Spirits respond brilliantly arriving; the divine thereby alights and stops.
translations.idiomatic: Spirits answer and gloriously descend; may the gods alight and stay.

sentences.zh: 登歌用進德南呂均之蕤賓羽：

translations.literal: Ascent hymn uses "Jinde"; Ruibin yu under the Nanlü tonal standard:
translations.idiomatic: Ascent hymn uses "Advancing Virtue," Ruibin yu in the Nanlü key:

translations.literal: Tushan fine kin; Gui-Rui honored marriage alliance.
translations.idiomatic: Noble kin of Tushan; honored alliance of Gui and Rui.

translations.literal: Ancestral feast at first opened; sacrificial canon just now declared.
translations.idiomatic: The sacrificial feast is newly opened; the rite of offerings now unfolds.

translations.literal: Rites thereby complete things; music thereby move spirits.
translations.idiomatic: Rites complete the offerings; music moves the spirits.

translations.literal: Use thereby elevating honest ordering; bearing harmonious ordinary relations.
translations.idiomatic: To honor kinship's bonds; to uphold human order in harmony.

sentences.zh: 俎入初獻用《褒德》大呂角：

translations.literal: Offering stands enter and first libation use "Baode"; Dalü jue:
translations.idiomatic: As stands are brought in for the first offering, "Praising Virtue," Dalü jue:

translations.literal: Family manifest accumulating benevolence; gate displays accumulated good.
translations.idiomatic: The family famed for piled-up virtue; the gate known for gathered goodness.

translations.literal: Jade baskets already arrayed; gold bells thereby displayed.
translations.idiomatic: Jade baskets stand in order; golden bells are raised to sound.

translations.literal: Martial dance:
translations.idiomatic: Martial Dance:

sentences.zh: 昭昭竹殿開，奕奕蘭宮啟。

translations.literal: Bright bright bamboo hall opens; flourishing flourishing orchid palace opens.
translations.idiomatic: Brightly the bamboo hall opens; splendidly the orchid palace unfolds.

sentences.zh: 懿範隆丹掖，殊榮辟硃邸。

translations.literal: Fine model elevated in cinnabar armpit; special glory opening vermilion mansion.
translations.idiomatic: Noble example rose in the inner palace; special honor opened a princely hall.

sentences.zh: 六佾薦微容，三簋陳芳醴。

translations.literal: Six rows presenting slight countenance; three gui displaying fragrant wine.
translations.idiomatic: Six rows of dancers present his gentle likeness; three gui bowls hold fragrant libations.

sentences.zh: 萬古覃貽厥，分珪崇祖禰。

translations.literal: Ten thousand ages spreading to leave posterity; dividing jade tablets honoring ancestors father and grandfather.
translations.idiomatic: For ten thousand years blessings pass to heirs; jade tablets honor forefathers and ancestors.

translations.literal: Secondary offering and sending off spirits use "Zhangde":
translations.idiomatic: For the second offering and Sending Off the Spirits, "Displaying Virtue":

translations.literal: Name elevated five sacred peaks; rank reflected three platforms.
translations.idiomatic: Their fame towers like the Five Peaks; their rank shines like the Three Platforms.

translations.literal: Solemn shrine already prepared; gentle countenance just now returning.
translations.idiomatic: The solemn rite is complete; the spirits' gentle faces turn homeward.
